title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1140: What big brother stone statue can do (2)

title.p: Chapter 1140: What big brother stone statue can do (2)

section.p: Countless people were shocked.
As for the other ancient city mayors, they felt immensely jealous.
Heavendoom City.
Mayor Tian He was losing his mind from the sheer envy he was feeling.
Holy shit!
Su Yu was actually capable of getting the stone statue to fight for him. In fact, he was actually capable of getting multiple stone statues to fight for him! What the fuck was that?

Tian He wanted to shout that he was a mayor as well! Why was he so much less important than Su Yu? Thirty-six stone statues? He couldn’t even make the stone statue of his city move. Just look at Su Yu! That was how an ancient city mayor should be! That was how an overlord should be!

Su Yu was a role model for all aspiring overlords. If anyone dared to threaten him, he would blow up their lair! So what if the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion was an ancient organization? So what if they had numerous Invincibles? What was there to fear? He would still make his demands known and threaten them with war if they refused.
Even the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion, with its eight Invincibles, desperately wanted to resolve this conflict.
How miserable.

Their Invincibles didn’t even know what had happened. Out of nowhere, thirty-six Invincibles had attacked their headquarters, revealing their location, and nearly causing them to be surrounded and annihilated. If they had not fled before the encirclement was formed, they would definitely need to lose some Invincibles to make an escape.
So was that an ancient city mayor in the truest sense? Tian He and all the other mayors were definitely fake mayors! They were so unloved that the stone statues wouldn’t care even if they all died.
Just look at Su Yu. That was a true winner in life.
He alone caused the Myriad Realms to cower.
Just look at how enjoyable his tenure as an ancient city mayor was. He would immediately strike back against any provocation.
At the same time.
Border of human territory, Eastrift Valley.
The Invincibles there were all stunned.

Great Xia King, in particular, was the most shocked. One could also say that he was confused. Xiao’er had informed him not long ago that Profound Nine was the one who had blasted his little grandson apart. And Profound Nine was Su Yu. In that case, who was the guy who had shocked the entire Myriad Realms after losing his temper?

Was he supposed to believe that Su Yu was able to make the thirty-six stone statues fight for him without even being there? Wasn’t that…a tad bit too crazy? Or perhaps his son had been fooled. That Profound Nine was not Su Yu.
Great Xia King felt greatly doubtful.
That must be it!

His face turned solemn. Yes, that was possible. Xiao’er had not met Su Yu himself. Thus, that Su Yu in Human Realm could very well be fake. Everything about Profound Nine might be one big lie. He had misled them by pretending to be Su Yu!
That was definitely the case! If even Great Xia King was starting to suspect that, who would believe that Profound Nine was actually Su Yu?
Great Qin King lamented, “Su Yu…Su Yu of the human race…sigh.”
His influence. His power.
He had truly turned into an overlord of a region.
After this incident, nobody would dare to provoke Su Yu anymore.

After a short while, Great Qin King had an amused expression as he said, “The Heavenly Hunt Pavilion is seeking our help to explain that they don’t have his father. Everything is a misunderstanding. They are offering to punish the people responsible and compensate him for this misunderstanding. They hope that he won’t further pursue this matter.”
The Invincibles were stunned yet again. Even the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion was cowering.
One of them asked in surprise, “They…actually bowed?”

Great Qin King said, “The Heavenly Hunt Pavilion fears no one. Not the devils. Not the divines. Not us. But clearly, they fear those ancient stone statues as those statues are capable of tracking them.”

Understanding dawned on the Invincibles. Their expressions changed. Yes, those stone statues could track the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion. No wonder they conceded so quickly. Most of their power came from their mysterious origins and concealment capabilities.

But now, the stone statues had revealed their ability to track the pavilion. With everyone aware of this, the next time this happened, it might really spell the end of the pavilion. Thus, what choice did the pavilion have but concede? Anyone would make the same choice in that position.

The Invincibles looked at each other speechlessly. The Heavenly Hunt Pavilion that had roamed the Allheaven Battlefield fearlessly for countless years had actually conceded to a puny Cloudbreach. They were even willing to punish their own people and pay to settle the issue. That was…truly inconceivable.
And the humans were not the only ones who were finding this inconceivable. The myriad races shared the same opinion. Nobody could believe this.
Human Realm.
The moment they heard of what happened, the jaws of Great Ming King and Zhu Tiandao dropped.
Father and son looked at each other in stupefaction.
After a long while, Great Ming King said, “That Profound Nine is not Su Yu! That’s a fake Su Yu!”
Zhu Tiandao stared at his father silently. Great Ming King continued staring at his son.
Really?
So Su Yu was still in the Allheaven Battlefield?

He was living in an unfettered manner, showcasing his overbearingness to the world. After this, perhaps not even the divines and devils would dare to provoke him anymore. How could he be in the Human Realm?
Had they been lied to? Their faces turned solemn. They had actually been fooled. That Profound Nine was the real Profound Nine, not Su Yu in disguise!
How terrifying.
That guy was able to fool even them! This was too terrifying!
At the same time.

Wan Tiansheng was quite speechless as well. He was the one who was fully aware of the whole story. If not, he would have captured the so-called Su Yu in the academy by now. After what just happened, anyone would suspect that the Su Yu in Human Realm was fake.
This…
Those ancient statues seemed to have placed a tad bit too much importance on him, right? Even Wan Tiansheng was finding this inconceivable.

As for Su Yu, he was not too concerned about what happened. Or to be precise, he was too occupied to care. The death qi in his body had suddenly increased massively in volume, forcing him to sit down cross-legged and start cultivating immediately.

Inwardly, he was cursing nonstop. He had yet to hear of what happened. As far as he was concerned, he had only asked the stone statue to solve a small problem for him. Why did he receive so much death qi in return?

What was the stone statue doing? What the fuck was that? He only asked the stone statue to do a small job. Why did the stone statue give him so much death qi in response? Did the stone statue leave the city again?
Su Yu continued cursing.
Looking at Su Yu who was busy dealing with death qi, Wan Tiansheng had a complicated expression. This kid sure was doing well in life. In fact, the kid was doing much better than him.
Wan Tiansheng thought that if he had the protection of the thirty-six ancient stone statues as well, he wouldn’t even bother to return any more.

Wan Tiansheng didn’t even know what to feel about this. Looking at Su Yu who was busy handling the death qi, Wan Tiansheng sighed and casually reached out. He easily grabbed the little furball and dragged the little fellow over. Then, the two stared at each other silently.
After a short silence, Wan Tiansheng smiled, “What a powerful bloodline. Any Invincible from your race will be the nightmare of all Invincibles.”

The little furball started trembling. Was this the prelude of death? Was this fellow trying to murder a ball? After following Su Yu for such a long time, the little furball had familiarized himself with the concept of eliminating a threat from its very roots.
Wan Tiansheng continued, “Cultivate well. According to the ancient records, the soul devourer race and the multiple character faction are perfect partners.”

Then, he stuffed the little furball back into Su Yu’s sea of consciousness. The trembling little furball started madly licking the characters in Su Yu’s sea of consciousness to calm his nervous heart.
At the same time.
Human Realm.
Heavenly Hunt Pavilion.
The enforcer elder’s head was lowered in silence. He was receiving countless messages through his mask.
“You dumb bastard! Are you aware of the trouble you caused?”
“Who told you to test Su Yu’s identity?”
“Idiot, who told you Profound Nine is Su Yu?”
“Brain! Do you have one?”
“Idiotic bastard! Do you know that your stupidity has nearly caused our destruction?”
He was being scolded.
He was being scolded by Invincibles. The Invincibles were furious.

The Invincibles had just found out that the entire thing had happened because of something stupid. Someone called Yellow Nine had claimed that Profound Nine was Su Yu. Then, Profound Nine told the pavilion to test Su Yu if they doubted him.
Holy shit!
Test his ass!
“Tell Yellow Nine to return immediately! No, capture Yellow Nine with your own hands! Track and kill him! That bastard is definitely a traitor!”
The Invincibles couldn’t even be bothered to investigate further.
Damn it!

Because of that bastard’s claim, the entire Heavenly Hunt Pavilion had suffered massively. Six Invincibles had suffered injuries. That was not the main issue here. More importantly, the curtain of mystery they had been hiding behind for so many years had been ripped apart.

Yes, the six Invincibles had yet to expose their real identities, but they had exposed too much of their strength. Even the location of their headquarters had been revealed. Even if they had moved away, that was still a big deal. Upon learning how all that had happened, the Invincible was infuriated.
“Su Yu is the overlord of a region. How can he be Profound Nine? Are you stupid? Do you have a brain?”

The Invincibles were furious. What were these people thinking? Also, the elder who had died in front of the city totally deserved it! How could that fool threaten Su Yu with his father? How would that not drive him mad? He must have paid a massive price to get all the stone statues to fight for him.
These Invincibles were not completely clueless about how the ancient cities worked. After a long while, the Invincibles finally managed to calm down a little.

“Idiot, if Profound Nine were really Su Yu, he would be dying from the backlash of death qi right about now. Just try to contact him. If he replies, there will no longer be any doubt that he’s not Su Yu. If you still suspect him even after that, you will be punished! Don’t think that you won’t be punished just because you’re an enforcer elder!”

The scolding continued. How infuriating! Their anger was understandable. For a simple claim made by Yellow Nine, they had provoked Su Yu. Sure, what the elder did wouldn’t be wrong if it did not result in such a backlash.

But since Su Yu was such an overbearing individual who had instantly taught the pavilion a lesson for challenging him, the elder naturally needed to take the blame. The entire branch was enveloped in silence. All of them had heard of what happened.
When they saw how the elder was behaving, they understood that the elder was probably being admonished by the higher-ups.
